title: Categories
emptyHint: Create a category to start sorting your transactions.
pickHint: Its spending history and subcategories show up here, next to the list.

deleteBlocked.system: You can't delete it: it's a system category.
deleteBlocked.notArchived: You can't delete it: it isn't archived.
deleteBlocked.hasTransactions: You can't delete it: it has transactions.
deleteBlocked.inFavorite: You can't delete it: it's used by a favorite.
deleteBlocked.inBudget: You can't delete it: it's assigned to a budget.

deleteBlockedSub.system: You can't delete it: its subcategory "{{name}}" is a system category.
deleteBlockedSub.notArchived: You can't delete it: its subcategory "{{name}}" isn't archived.
deleteBlockedSub.hasTransactions: You can't delete it: its subcategory "{{name}}" has transactions.
deleteBlockedSub.inFavorite: You can't delete it: its subcategory "{{name}}" is used by a favorite.
deleteBlockedSub.inBudget: You can't delete it: its subcategory "{{name}}" is assigned to a budget.

archiveBody: You won't be able to pick it for new transactions, but the ones that already have it keep it. You can unarchive it anytime.
archiveBodySubs_one: You won't be able to pick it for new transactions. This also archives {{count}} subcategory: {{names}}. Transactions that already have them keep them. You can unarchive each one anytime.
archiveBodySubs_other: You won't be able to pick it for new transactions. This also archives {{count}} subcategories: {{names}}. Transactions that already have them keep them. You can unarchive each one anytime.
deleteBodySubs_one: This also deletes {{count}} subcategory: {{names}}. This can't be undone.
deleteBodySubs_other: This also deletes {{count}} subcategories: {{names}}. This can't be undone.

form.name: Name
form.typeLocked: You can't change the type while it has subcategories. Move or delete them first.
form.subcategoryNote: It'll be created as a subcategory (it inherits the type).
